audience: freight forwarders and importers that track ocean containers and air cargo in ShipsGo

useCases.title: Start tracking an ocean shipment
useCases.text: Start tracking an ocean shipment by its booking number or container number. It uses account credits, but a repeat returns the existing shipment at no cost. Then read its status and events.

useCases.title: Read the route of a shipment
useCases.text: Read the route of an ocean or air shipment as GeoJSON, with its ports or airports and track points.

useCases.title: List ocean shipments by status or carrier
useCases.text: List the ocean shipments of the account. Filter them by status, carrier, reference or container number. List the carrier codes first to pick a carrier.

useCases.title: Find an air cargo shipment by its AWB number
useCases.text: List air cargo shipments by status, reference or AWB number. Open one shipment to read its movements and AWB details.

useCases.title: Change the reference of a shipment
useCases.text: Change the reference of an ocean or air shipment. Only the reference changes.

useCases.title: Delete a shipment after approval
useCases.text: Delete an ocean or air shipment after the user approves it. Tracking stops, and this server cannot restore the shipment.
